AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Leftover Food? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Leftover Food.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Leftover Food.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Leftover Food.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Leftover Food.

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

4. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Animal Feed: Hay? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.

13. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

14. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Storage of Crop Produce? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Storage of Crop Produce.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Storage of Crop Produce.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Storage of Crop Produce.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Storage of Crop Produce.

16. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Grafting in Plants 13 4.2 Homemade Sun Dryer 13 Total Number of Lessons 120 Note and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Grafting in Plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Homemade Sun Dryer and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
